Hi everyone,
Did you have any issues while entering Israel on ETA (I'm from EU country) to visit your Israeli partner, before even starting the whole visa process? I'm planning to travel to Israel and stay for a few months. I've already spent there 2 months in May and June. And definitely planning to make more such trips before applying for partner visa.

I'm starting to worry, that I will have some issues at immigration, since I'm staying longer than usual tourists do. 

Thanks a lot 🙂
